entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Inner Sea Gods
entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your god’s blessing heals the body and hardens the skin.

Prerequisite(s): Channel energy 7d6, worshiper of a deity of metal, stone, or mountains

Benefit(s): Once per day when you channel positive energy to heal living creatures, you can grant healed creatures damage reduction. Affected creatures gain DR 2/— (or increase their DR/— by 2, if they already have DR/—) for a number of minutes equal to your Charisma bonus (minimum 1 minute).
